notes.title: Hotel Renovator Patch 7 is live!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36459112/c890d64d1a317ff7fdf823253703ade25c5f55eb.png[/img]

[b][h3]Greetings, Renovators![/h3][/b]

We're thrilled to announce the release of [b]Patch 7[/b], bringing a slew of fixes and improvements to enhance your hotel renovation experience. Thank you for your valuable feedback, and we hope these changes make your renovation journey even more enjoyable. Without further ado, here are the patch notes:

[b]Bug Fixes:[/b]

[list]
[*] Fixed the issue causing delays in unlocking the Penthouse booking feature.
[*] Resolved the problem of NPCs getting stuck in the elevator. Your guests can now move freely!
[*] Updated additional requirements for Room 104 in Story Mode to reflect the latest changes accurately.
[*] The pause button is now added. Stop the time whenever you need it!
[*] Added the Field of View (FOV) functionality in the UI. Adjust your perspective seamlessly.
[*] You can now complete the cleaning of the Penthouse without any issues. Happy cleaning!
[*] Addressed the community concern regarding one of the colour names. The colour is now appropriately named.
[*] Fixed the bug that caused players to pay multiple times for painting the same wall with the same colour.
[*] Special guest objectives can now be completed as intended. Track your progress accurately.
[*] Addressed the issue where additional floors were wrongly signed after restarting the game. Book with confidence!
[*] Fixed the bug causing simultaneous playback of Brilliant Memory and Party Time cutscenes.
[*] The progress of the Full Moon Guest mission is now accurately reflected in the UI for Black and Red shades.
[*] Resolved the issue, causing guests to appear as multiple wedding guests in The Wedding mission.
[/list]

Thank you for your continued support and dedication to making [b]Hotel Renovator[/b] better with each update. We appreciate your patience and look forward to hearing your thoughts on these improvements.

[h3]Happy renovating![/h3]

notes.title: Hotel Renovator Patch 6 Now Live!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36459112/e4a8f422f8efdc79c260b1bde20a84e34eb0d351.png[/img]

We're thrilled to announce the release of [b]Patch 6[/b] for [b]Hotel Renovator[/b], packed with fixes and improvements to enhance your renovation experience. Here's a rundown of what's been addressed.

[b]Patch Notes:[/b]

[list]
[*] We've restored the missing visual effect for surface destruction, making your renovation efforts more satisfying than ever.
[*] We've fixed the issue that prevented the removal of paint from panels after panel destruction. Now you can renovate with precision and without any lingering paint woes.
[*] No more overlapping text! We've cleaned up the UI in the "Mods made by You" screen, ensuring a seamless modding experience.
[*] Long category names are no longer a problem! We've adjusted the in-game frame to accommodate those lengthy category names when creating mods.
[*] Renovate your disco floors with ease! We've improved renovation performance by enhancing the flooring division.
[*] No more delays in unlocking Floor 2! We've resolved the issue, ensuring a smooth progression experience.
[*] Say goodbye to texture delays! We've optimized the loading of textures for player-affected surfaces, enhancing overall performance.
[*] We've fixed the issue causing simultaneous tips to appear on unrenovated additional floors, providing clearer guidance during renovations.
[*] Enjoy precise wall decoration placement on the third floor! Minimalist Wall Panel 3 and Deco Wall Panel 3 can no longer be placed separately from the wall.
[*] NPC heads are now solid! We've eliminated the issue of seeing through NPC heads for a more immersive experience.
[*] Objects will stay where they belong! We've prevented objects from being placed outside the hotel boundaries.
[*] Renovate without performance hiccups! FPS drops after placing multiple cleaning robots have been addressed.
[*] Stay informed about your mods! We've added warnings to alert you when installed mods become unavailable.
[/list]
Get ready to dive back into the world of [b]Hotel Renovator[/b] with [b]Patch 6[/b], and experience smoother, more polished renovations than ever before. 

[h3]Thank you for your continued support, and happy renovating![/h3]

notes.title: New content add-on and Patch 5 are here
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36459112/8db10af927d75ea468183d6aee7ae8252358bdfa.png[/img]

[b]Hello, Renovators![/b]

Are your guests complaining about the lack of amenities? It’s time to change that! The latest [b]Hotel Renovator[/b] DLC finally introduces something for the muscles instead of the brains.

With the [b][url=https://store.steampowered.com/dlc/1214470/Hotel_Renovator/]Gym Furniture Set[/url][/b] DLC for [b]Hotel Renovator[/b], you can transform the additional room on the 2nd floor into a state-of-the-art fitness centre. After all, every premium hotel needs a workout space – even if some guests never bother to use it.

But not all guests are like the hero of our latest short video. He’s truly dedicated to the art of muscle-building but may lack a bit in the gym etiquette department. Watch the ad and make sure you never repeat his mistake.

[previewyoutube=KFlVuZHUEDk;full][/previewyoutube]

[b]The Gym Furniture Set DLC[/b] is available today! Get it now and provide your guests with a fitness facility they'll never want to leave!

[h3]Apart from the DLC, we are also introducing Patch 5 which takes care of the following issues:[/h3]

[list]
[*] Fixed a number of incorrectly used rendering features (like hardware tessellation) in NPCs' materials - was causing the materials to either glitch out or just straight up crash the graphics driver on some older GPUs.
[*] Fixed a rare crash caused by some corrupted texture imports in one of the lobby decorations.
[*] Fixed a couple situations in which loading into a savefile while a popup (event message, interaction prompt) was meant to appear right at the save point would cause the player to be blocked from moving and the game time would be frozen.
[*] Fixed an issue where room flooding from the Cracked Pipe event experienced in one game would transfer to subsequently opened save files
[*] Fixed a rare case in which the Engagement Ring would not spawn correctly in the swimming pool after the patio renovation event is over, blocking player progress.
[/list]

notes.title: Patch 4 is here! Bug fixes and free ceilings!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36459112/518fa288e8587b64a0cab069a92caa7e22e5960c.png[/img]

[h3]Renovators,[/h3]

We are thrilled to announce that [b]Patch 4[/b] is now live! This latest update includes several important bug fixes, which we hope will significantly improve your gaming experience.

We have been closely monitoring your feedback since the launch of [b]Hotel Renovator[/b], and we have identified some of the most frequently reported bugs. We know that these issues have been causing frustration and inconvenience for many of you, and we wanted to address them as quickly as possible.

[h3]Here are some of the key fixes included in Patch 4:[/h3]

[list]
[*] The issue causing the game to crash at boot with "'RuntimeFileDialogs' failed to load" error message has been eliminated
[*] The bug causing the Iguanas from the Wild Enthusiast Special Guest quest to stay in the hotel indefinitely has been fixed
[*] The bugs causing the multiple issues on the same type Additional Floors purchased on top of the other have been resolved
[*] The objective issues present while switching between the same type of Additional Floors have been fixed
[*] The issue causing the NPC to not appear in the Restaurant area after finishing The Wedding event has been fixed
[*] The issue causing the save file corruption while doing the Elevator Malfunction Random Event has been eliminated
[*] The bug causing a piece of trash to respawn in the Restaurant area has been fixed
[*] The glitch causing some NPC to get stuck in the Elevator has been fixed
[*] The issue causing all robot vacuums to get stuck after game restart has been eliminated
[*] The bug causing The Wedding guests to go to the Elevator instead of the Restaurant has been fixed
[*] The issue causing a different wall colour to show from the 1st Floor balcony above the Lobby has been eliminated
[*] The bug causing a black line to appear above windows after renovation has been fixed
[*] The issue preventing the player from covering a part of the floor near the Sauna entrance has been fixed
[*] The issue causing the Golden Egg popup to skip in the Tutorial after selling the Maps painting has been eliminated
[/list]
[h3]Other minor fixes:[/h3]

[list]
[*] The issue causing intense shadows to appear in the corners of the Otus table has been eliminated
[*] The glitch causing the Cowboy's hat to disappear at a very close distance has been fixed
[*] The issue causing BB101 to use Sandra's voice after entering room 104 during The Wedding quest has been fixed
[*] The issue with displaying the Dice score in the Dice Battle Random Event has been fixed
[*] Some additional localisation issues have been resolved
[/list]

We are confident that these fixes will go a long way in improving your overall gameplay experience. We also want to take this opportunity to thank you for your continued support and feedback. Your input is invaluable to us, and we are committed to ensuring that [b]Hotel Renovator[/b] remains a fun and engaging game for all our players.

But that’s not enough of the good news. The latest patch also comes with a small update that we have been teasing recently. The [b]Ceiling Renovation[/b] category is [b]now available[/b] in your Pie Menu! The new tool allows for a fun and easy ceiling renovation using the same patterns as in the walls category and some brand-new panels designed specifically for ceilings.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36459112/b1f2a2a386f841c934305b9418c436110b28df0c.gif[/img]

Make sure your game is properly updated and please keep sharing your thoughts and suggestions with us, and we will continue to work hard to make Hotel Renovator the best it can be.

notes.title: Patch 3 has arrived with plenty of fixes!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36459112/45d3ebb1f2f79176e11a3a2c9a6fbea776ae6a35.png[/img]

[h3]Greetings, Renovators! [/h3]

We're excited to announce that [b]Patch 3[/b] is now live for Hotel Renovator. This patch addresses numerous bugs and issues reported by our community, as well as improving controller support and fixing localization problems.

[b]Here are the highlights of the fixes in Patch 3:[/b]

[list]
[*] Fixed the Party Time quest bug where it appeared without any objectives.
[*] Fixed the bug causing multiple purchases of floors while using the controller.
[*] Fixed the Price of Service bug while having multiple new save files in Sandbox Mode.
[*] Language for Chinese have been changed to zh-Hans, zh-Hant – Simplified Chinese, Traditional Chinese. The code we previously used with intention to symbolize Chinese Traditional was interpreted by the engine as Chinese Taipei.
[*] Eliminated some additional localization issues.
[*] Fixed a bug causing the Elevator Malfunction Random Event to not trigger on additional floors.
[*] Fixed gaps between deco actors.
[*] Fixed the spawning of the wallet in Lost Wallet Random Event.
[*] The pop-up about missing DLC can now be closed using a controller.

[h3]Hi Renovators![/h3]

As promised, we are introducing a new set of fixes to [b]Hotel Renovator[/b] with the launch of [b]Patch 2[/b]. The new patch addresses the most common issues you have brought to our attention since tha game launched. Here is the full list of introduced fixes:

[list]
[*] A progression block after picking up the bellboy suit and closing the game has been eliminated
[*] Missing lobby decoration issues have been fixed
[*] The restaurant cleaning progression issue has been fixed
[*] The issue causing the game to crash while the player is in the basement has been fixed
[*] The issue causing the game to crash while loading the lobby area has been fixed
[*] The issue causing the Hotel Naming pop-up to freeze after the player uses Alt+Tab has been fixed
[*] Long loading times during game launch have been eliminated
[*] The issue with the player being unable to complete the “Catch the Chicken” quest has been resolved
[*] The issue causing the “Fill Mode” tutorial not to appear has been fixed
[*] Issues with playing the intro in both game modes have been fixed
[*] The issue with each next floor of the same type being a partial duplicate of the one below has been resolved
[*] The issue with spawning a second ghost when the player restarts the game during the “Ghost Hunting” quest has been resolved
[*] The issue causing the “Noisy Neighbour” quest to block on the third floor has been fixed
[*] Horse animation bugs have been fixed
[*] The bug allowing the player to finish the tutorial without going to the “Booking App” has been eliminated
[*] The on-screen keyboard functionality issue while naming the hotel has been fixed
[*] The issue with unreadable tips in the journal has been fixed
[*] The “Lost and Found” quest item spawning issues have been resolved
[*] The issue causing Room 203 to be accessible to the player before the story quest has been eliminated
[*] The issue causing a part of the lobby to remain unrenovated has been fixed
[*] The issue causing a piece of flooring next to the main entrance to remain unrenovated has been fixed
[*] The issue causing the player to get stuck in the elevator floor texture has been resolved
[*] The handyman NPC clipping through the floor issue has been resolved
[*] Floor and Wall materials and colours now match their thumbnails

Thank you so much for your patience. We aim to make [b]Hotel Renovator[/b] an enjoyable experience for everyone, and we’re surely not done fixing the smaller issues. We will be updating you about future updates.

The launch of [b]Hotel Renovator[/b] has been huge for us! We see a lot of amazing designs from you guys on our Discord and social media. notes.title: Set a trap, and catch the ghost!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36459112/25451eb3d8431cc978d01cc1ff9a5c63d7d2d0dc.png[/img]

Yes, we know that the spooky holiday is long gone, but we also know some of you are still struggling with catching that scary ghost that is haunting our hotel! We want you to sort him out once and for all and bring the light to the place once again. 

[h3]1[/h3]
Play the Hotel Renovator demo and at some point of your renovation, the lights will go out. Suddenly, an uninvited ghost appears! Don’t be afraid. Select the [b]Halloween items[/b] section and select a buy a ghost-trap, then place it on the ground in a place that the ghost might hover over.

[h3]2[/h3]
Then, grab a vacuum cleaner and when the ghost appears again, use it on him, to get him into the trap! Once you’ve captured it, the light and the music go back on and you can continue your renovation.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36459112/1f1ef3d716a8391403ec9ebe5a82934a75ea0052.png[/img]

[b]You can also sell the trapped ghost for a lot of money![/b]


Remember that there are also pumpkin lamps, Cauldrons, cats, and other spooky decorations added to the demo, plus some cool Halloween wallpapers :) 
[h3]Have fun![/h3]
